definitions.gloss: center of gravity; center of mass
definitions.explanation: The point at which the weight of a body is concentrated and around which it balances.
The central focus or primary emphasis of an effort, argument, or activity.

examples.japanese: {重心|じゅうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{低|ひく}く→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To lower one's center of gravity.

examples.english: If your center of gravity tilts forward, you're likely to fall.

notes:
Composed of {重|じゅう} (weight/heavy) and {心|しん} (center/core). In sense 1, it is a physics term; in sense 2, it is used figuratively to mean the main focus or emphasis of something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重心|じゅうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧: to shift the center of gravity / shift focus
- {重心|じゅうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{低|ひく}く→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lower one's center of gravity
- {重心|じゅうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to place emphasis on
- {重心|じゅうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: center of gravity stabilizes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重点|じゅうてん}→重点：14416_juuten⟧: emphasis, priority — more commonly used for figurative "focus" in everyday contexts
- ⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧: balance — loanword, often used in physical and figurative contexts
- ⟦{焦点|しょうてん}→焦点：13413_shouten⟧: focal point — used for the focus of discussion or attention
